title: AARYA Voice Lab Model Registry Record
description: One entry in the model registry (docs/MODEL_STRATEGY.md, docs/SECURITY.md). model_type distinguishes the Default Voice model line from the Private Voice model line; private_voice entries require the security_metadata block.

provider.description: e.g. 'local', or a specific open-source project name. Never a paid cloud TTS API in this project (see docs/PRIVACY.md).

architecture.description: Real Voice Model Engine milestone. Model architecture family, e.g. 'titanet' or 'piper-vits'. Null while unknown/not yet trained.

lifecycle_state.description: pipeline.model_lifecycle.ModelLifecycleState. Null only for registry entries created before this milestone.

embedding_model_ref.description: Which embedding model (if any) this voice model's identity is derived from.

generation_model_ref.description: Which generation/TTS model (if any) this registry entry names.

training_config_hash.description: pipeline.training.TrainingConfig.config_hash for the job that produced this model, if any.

source_job_id.description: pipeline.training.TrainingJob.job_id that produced this model, if any.

artifact_checksum.description: pipeline.model_artifact.ModelArtifact.checksum_sha256 for this model's stored weights, if any.

required_permission.description: Permission string enforced by AARYA Core, e.g. 'voice.private.use'.

storage_protection.description: Description of where/how the model is stored (e.g. 'encrypted-at-rest, restricted ACL').

frontend_direct_access.description: Must be false — no frontend-only authorization path to this model.
